author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-gamma0.73-k48: ComBat PCA(64) Embedding + Residualized-PC BalancedGraph (γ=0.73, k=48)
abstract: Dual-output BRBG with ComBat-corrected PCA embedding (64 PCs) and residualized-PC BalancedGraph using γ=0.73 (l2=1e-3), batch-balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary). Tests if slightly lighter residualization than 0.74 further improves ARI/NMI while maintaining batch metrics, potentially exceeding 0.7188.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from brbg_dual_comb_resid_graph import dual_output_brbg
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return dual_output_brbg(
        adata,
        n_pcs_emb=64,
        n_pcs_graph=50,
        gamma=0.73,
        l2=1e-3,
        k_total=48,
        metric='cosine'
    )
